name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Plain Steamed Jasmine White Rice Cup
whyItWorks: One of the best emergency flare-safe hacks in Disneyland! Warm, fluffy steamed white jasmine rice with zero butter, oil, spices, or seeds. Soothes an upset stomach immediately.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a cup of plain steamed white rice (request no spicy seasonings or furikake seeds).
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe theme park carbohydrate
